svg.aria-label: self-healing-infra: an EC2 web server that repairs itself. A health metric is reported every minute; when nginx stops, a CloudWatch alarm invokes Lambda, which restarts nginx through Systems Manager. The drawing shows the metric dropping from 1 to 0, the alarm, the restart and the return to OK.

A health metric is reported every minute; when nginx stops, a CloudWatch alarm invokes Lambda, which restarts nginx through Systems Manager. svg.text: An EC2 web server that repairs itself. A health
check reports to CloudWatch every minute; when
nginx stops, or the instance goes quiet, an alarm
invokes Lambda, which restarts nginx through
Systems Manager. No SSH, nobody paged.
Provisioned end to end with Terraform
one sample a minute · silence counts as a failure
